title: Base change of a curve

proof.text: Apply baseChange_dim for the equality of dimensions. Mathlib pullback stability supplies separatedness, local finite type and quasi-compactness; rewrite the curve dimension bound with this equality to construct IsCurve.
Smoothness and properness follow from Mathlib smooth_isStableUnderBaseChange and IsProper.isStableUnderBaseChange via the canonical pullback square.

For affine C, its structure map to the affine Spec(k) is an affine morphism. Mathlib affine-morphism pullback stability and the affine target Spec(k') give an affine pullback. This uses the existing IsAffineHom instances, with no tensor-product theorem needed in this clause.

For a connected curve, use its ConnectedSpace instance and GeometricallyConnected.of_connectedSpace_of_isSepClosed (k is algebraically closed, hence separably closed). The base-changed morphism is geometrically connected; GeometricallyConnected.connectedSpace_of_subsingleton gives ConnectedSpace of its source since Spec(k') is a nonempty one-point space. Combine this with the already constructed IsCurve and the dimension equality to construct IsConnectedCurve.

statement_change.old_statement:
Let $k\subseteq k'$ be algebraically closed and let $C$ be a
curve over $k$. Then $C_{k'}$ is a
smooth separated curve over $k'$ of the same dimension, and
$C_{k'}$ is proper (resp. affine) if $C$ is proper (resp. affine).
